issues.description: The template implementation of construct_zero_state_prep_circuit creates a Stim Circuit using stim.Circuit(offset) (calling the Circuit constructor with an integer argument). The problem statement and the solution both treat the circuit as created with stim.Circuit() and expect the function to use the provided offset to relabel or address qubits (not to pass an offset into the Circuit constructor). Calling stim.Circuit(offset) in the template is inconsistent with the solution and likely with the Stim API, and can cause confusion or runtime errors when students try to run or test the provided template code.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the incorrect stim.Circuit(offset) call from the template. Construct the Stim circuit with stim.Circuit() (no arguments) and apply the qubit offset by relabeling targets (as done in the solution's relabel_qubits helper) or by creating the circuit at default indices and shifting indices when appending. Document in the template that offset must be handled by relabeling rather than by passing it to the Circuit constructor.
